description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes; Boyawanthalawa Tea Estates PLS Vs. Mr. J. W. K. Bandara and three Other Settlement Orders
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders and revocations of orders for arbitration of industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister of Labour is incidental to the legal authority making the orders, not the focus of the content.
